mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_profile (station_id, name, title, rank_name, phone_cipher, cyl_type, nfc_tag, height_cm, weight_kg, age, morning_pressure, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{rankName}, #{phoneCipher}, #{cylType}, #{nfcTag}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{age}, #{morningPressure}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_profile SET name = #{name}, title = #{title}, rank_name = #{rankName}, phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher}, cyl_type = #{cylType}, nfc_tag = #{nfcTag}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, age = #{age}, morning_pressure = #{morningPressure}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
